long_biography.plain_text:
Worboys studied valuation and estate management at Bristol Polytechnic before joining Strutt & Parker in 1981. He later led Gazeley’s European expansion and held senior roles at Panattoni. He then became chief executive of P3 Logistic Parks, overseeing a decade of growth across European warehouse markets.

After leaving P3, Worboys launched Trammell Crow Company’s European logistics operation and built teams across several countries. In 2024, he co-founded European Green Logistics Space with Amos Chia and Glen Lonie in partnership with Kamco Invest. The company develops new logistics facilities and acquires older warehouses for environmental upgrades, combining his long industrial-property career with a sustainability-led investment strategy.
